Heatmap Fleet Analytics

Location History Exception History Leave groups or zones clear to include all available vehicles or locations.
Instructions
  1. Choose to visualize by location history or exception history.
  2. If visualizing by exception history, select one or more rules to search.
  3. Optionally select a group type and vehicle group, then select the vehicle(s) to search.
  4. Optionally select zone types to narrow the zone list, then select zones to include only records inside them.
  5. In exception history, untick Show heatmap layer to keep exception data and event details without heat colouring.
  6. Tick Show school speed zones to overlay the NZTA school speed zones for the current map view; events over a school-zone limit are counted in the school-zone legend and show that limit on their sign.
  7. Specify a date/time range and click Show Results.
  8. Use Refresh data after changing the MyGeotab Groups Filter or when fleet data changes.
  9. Open a Rule or Vehicle dropdown and tick every item you want to include.
